name: Tsinghua University
tuitionNote: Official Tsinghua international admissions page (international.join-tsinghua.edu.cn) cites CNY 30,000/year for science & engineering undergraduate programs (CNY 26,000/year for some economics/management/law programs). Converted at ~1 CNY = 0.13 EUR. Master's tuition not separately confirmed from official source in this search; bachelor figure reused as an estimate — verify exact graduate tuition before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: High school diploma, strong academic transcripts, HSK/English proficiency depending on program medium, entrance exam or interview for some majors, financial guarantee letter.
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree in relevant field, transcripts, two recommendation letters, research proposal/statement of purpose, HSK Level 5 (Chinese-taught) or IELTS/TOEFL (English-taught programs).
scholarshipDetails: Tsinghua is a confirmed Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) host institution; CSC covers tuition, on-campus accommodation, and a monthly stipend, and is open to Bangladeshi applicants via the CSC Type A (Chinese Embassy) or Type B (university) channels.

name: Peking University
tuitionNote: Official PKU International Student Office (isd.pku.edu.cn) materials and Beijing municipal government page cite CNY 26,000/year (humanities/social sciences) to CNY 30,000/year (science & engineering) for undergraduates; this entry uses the CNY 30,000 figure. Graduate (Master's) tuition cited at CNY 29,000-94,000/year depending on program; lower bound CNY 29,000 used here — actual program-specific fee can be much higher, verify before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: High school diploma with strong grades, HSK Level 5 (Chinese-taught programs) or IELTS/TOEFL (English-taught), application essay, interview for some majors.
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree, official transcripts, two academic reference letters, research/study plan, language proficiency proof (HSK or IELTS/TOEFL depending on program).
scholarshipDetails: Peking University is a confirmed CSC (Chinese Government Scholarship) host institution; the scholarship covers tuition, accommodation, and a living stipend and is available to Bangladeshi students through embassy or university-direct application routes.

name: Fudan University
tuitionNote: Official Fudan sources (econ.fudan.edu.cn, iss.fudan.edu.cn) and aggregator data report Bachelor's tuition ranging CNY 23,000-40,000/year and Master's CNY 28,000-50,000/year depending on major; this entry uses representative mid-range figures of CNY 30,000 (Bachelor) and CNY 35,000 (Master). Actual program-specific fees vary substantially — verify exact figures for the intended major before publishing. Specialized programs (e.g. IMBA at CNY 369,800) are excluded as non-representative.
bachelorRequirements: High school diploma, academic transcripts, HSK Level 4-5 (Chinese-taught) or IELTS/TOEFL (English-taught programs), personal statement, recommendation letters.
masterRequirements: Relevant Bachelor's degree, transcripts, two recommendation letters, research proposal/personal statement, Chinese or English proficiency certificate depending on program medium.
scholarshipDetails: Fudan University is a confirmed CSC (Chinese Government Scholarship) host institution, with tuition, accommodation, and stipend coverage available to eligible Bangladeshi applicants.

name: Shanghai Jiao Tong University
tuitionNote: SOURCE CONFLICT FLAGGED: aggregator data (gotouniversity/shiksha-style sources) cites CNY 100,000-120,000/year for international undergraduate tuition (non-Business Administration majors at CNY 100,000/year, Business Administration at CNY 120,000/year), which is far above typical Chinese public-university international fees and could reflect a joint-venture or premium program rather than the standard SJTU undergraduate track. CNY 100,000/year used here as the lower of the two cited figures. Master's tuition more consistently cited at CNY 28,900/year across sources. Verify the undergraduate figure against SJTU's official admissions office before publishing — it may apply only to specific Sino-foreign joint programs (e.g. SJTU-Michigan, Antai Business School) rather than all majors.
bachelorRequirements: High school diploma, strong academic record, HSK Level 5 (Chinese-taught) or IELTS/TOEFL (English-taught programs), entrance assessment for some majors.
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree in relevant field, official transcripts, recommendation letters, research proposal, Chinese/English language proficiency proof depending on program.
scholarshipDetails: SJTU is a confirmed CSC (Chinese Government Scholarship) host institution, with full coverage of tuition, accommodation, and a monthly stipend for eligible international students including Bangladeshi applicants.

name: Zhejiang University
tuitionNote: Aggregator and ZJU-affiliated institute sources cite undergraduate engineering/science tuition around CNY 28,000-35,000/year; mid-range CNY 30,000 used here. Specialized joint programs (e.g. MBBS at CNY 50,000-60,000/year, ZJU-Edinburgh/Illinois international campus at CNY 50,000-80,000/year) are excluded as non-representative of standard tracks. Master's tuition figure not separately confirmed from an official source in this search — bachelor figure reused as an estimate; verify before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: High school diploma, academic transcripts, HSK Level 4-5 (Chinese-taught) or IELTS/TOEFL (English-taught), application essay.
masterRequirements: Relevant Bachelor's degree, transcripts, recommendation letters, research proposal, language proficiency certificate (HSK or IELTS/TOEFL).
scholarshipDetails: Zhejiang University is a confirmed CSC (Chinese Government Scholarship) host institution offering tuition, accommodation, and stipend coverage; Bangladeshi students are eligible to apply via embassy or university channels.

name: University of Science and Technology of China (USTC)
tuitionNote: Official USTC source (en.ustc.edu.cn) and International College fee pages cite CNY 26,000/year for Bachelor's programs, CNY 30,000/year for Master's programs, and CNY 35,000/year for Doctoral programs. Figures used directly from official source.
bachelorRequirements: High school diploma, strong academic transcripts, HSK Level 4-5 (Chinese-taught) or IELTS/TOEFL (English-taught programs), entrance assessment for science/engineering majors.
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree in relevant field, transcripts, recommendation letters, research proposal, Chinese or English proficiency certificate depending on program medium.
scholarshipDetails: USTC offers the USTC Fellowship and is a confirmed CSC (Chinese Government Scholarship) host institution, covering tuition, insurance, accommodation subsidy, and monthly stipend for qualifying international students.

name: Nanjing University
tuitionNote: Aggregator sources (shiksha, official NJU-affiliated college pages) cite CNY 35,000-45,000 for the first year of international undergraduate study, varying by program; mid-range CNY 40,000 used here. masterRequirements: Relevant Bachelor's degree, official transcripts, recommendation letters, research proposal, Chinese or English language proficiency proof depending on program.
scholarshipDetails: Nanjing University is a confirmed CSC (Chinese Government Scholarship) host institution, providing tuition, accommodation, and stipend coverage to eligible international students, including those from Bangladesh.

name: Wuhan University
tuitionNote: DATA-INTEGRITY CAUTION: Wuhan University (武汉大学) is frequently confused in search results with the separate, lower-profile 'Wuhan University of Science and Technology' (武汉科技大学) and 'Wuhan University of Technology' (武汉理工大学). Sources that appear specific to Wuhan University's own admissions office (admission.whu.edu.cn, whu.cucas.cn) indicate a range of roughly CNY 20,000-40,000/year for undergraduate international tuition without a single authoritative figure isolated for a representative major; CNY 30,000/year (mid-range) is used here as a placeholder estimate. This figure could NOT be confirmed with full confidence as distinct from figures belonging to the similarly-named Science & Technology or Technology institutions — verify the exact tuition directly from admission.whu.edu.cn before publishing. Master's tuition reuses the same estimated figure and carries the same caveat.
bachelorRequirements: High school diploma, academic transcripts, HSK Level 4-5 (Chinese-taught) or IELTS/TOEFL (English-taught programs), application review.
masterRequirements: Relevant Bachelor's degree, official transcripts, recommendation letters, research proposal, Chinese or English proficiency certificate depending on program medium.

Master's programs (e.g. business) cited around CNY 30,000/year, same figure used; specialized IMBA programs (CNY 60,000-90,000/year) excluded as non-representative. bachelorRequirements: High school diploma, academic transcripts, HSK Level 4-5 (Chinese-taught) or IELTS/TOEFL (English-taught programs), application essay.
masterRequirements: Relevant Bachelor's degree, transcripts, recommendation letters, research proposal, Chinese or English language proficiency proof depending on program.
scholarshipDetails: Sun Yat-sen University offers the Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) as well as its own SYSU International Student Scholarship, which together can cover up to 100% of tuition for qualifying international students, including Bangladeshi applicants.
